title: Chapter 378
text:
Han Xiao was a little surprised. He had only planned to let the slaves go and thought that the slaves would be eager to return home. He did not expect that there would be people willing to stay. He asked them in detail and decided to take in the three of them.

The three Volga brothers were from the Tamiharentines. This was a small civilization in the Shattered Star Ring. Their civilization level was equivalent to Sunil before the disaster, and they had a certain level of space travel ability. They were a Magic-type civilization that focused on the psychic branch. Their race's specialty was telepathy, and they could complete the exchange of information by looking at each other. To a certain extent, they did not need to speak, and telepathy was the strongest between close relatives.

The technological foundation of their civilization was the First Demon mineral vein, and they developed a technological tree based on materials that contained magic as the energy source. They had a religion and a high fertility rate. They would mate, reproduce, and give birth to animals. The incubation time was about a year. Normal humans would give birth to one child at a time, but the Tamiharentines would give birth a few times in their lifetime. They had always been troubled by the problem of population expansion.

The Tamiharentines looked similar to humans, but they were shorter, with an average height of 1.6 meters. They had white skin and natural runes on their bodies. The more eye-catching feature was their pure white eyes, which were like a whole piece of white crystal. The Tamiharentines had very high psychic talents. If they awakened, most of them would become Psychics.

The eldest and second of the three Volga brothers were both Psychics, and the youngest was a Mage. They were all Grade C Supers, around LV 70. Although their strength was average, they made up for the lack of classes in the mercenary group. This way, the mercenary group finally had five Super classes, making up for the lack of abilities.

"Mages can perform blessings and enchantments to add new abilities to machines, which can indirectly increase my combat strength."

Han Xiaoxin was very happy. The Black Star Mercenary had three new officers, which increased the faction reward limit by almost ten thousand points. The limit was now 185,000 points.

The three brothers were full of respect and gratitude. They accepted Han Xiao's arrangement. Even if they were free, they would still continue to be mercenaries. Instead of working alone, they would rather join Han Xiao's team. Other than repaying his kindness with their bodies, they could also take care of each other.

After accepting the three brothers, it was time to solve the problem of Aroshia. Han Xiao pondered. The mission required him to keep her by his side for six days. There had to be a reason, and it would not be completed smoothly. Although he did not know the exact reason, he just had to do as he was told.

What troubled him was how to deal with Aroshia's identity. Should she also become a mercenary? However, although Aroshia had a high energy reaction, she did not seem to know how to use it in battle. It was unclear whether it was her racial talent or her personal strength. Furthermore, she had completely lost her memory. There was no way to know her identity and communicate with her.

The others were eagerly waiting for Han Xiao to explain the background of this great beauty.

"Her name is Aroshia. She is also a rescued slave. From today onwards, she will temporarily follow us," Han Xiao said.

Mad Blade was puzzled. "Why did you keep her? Also, why isn't she saying anything? " He had been wanting to ask this question for a long time. Ever since Han Xiao had brought her out, Aroshia had not opened her mouth. Although her appearance was extremely in line with human aesthetics and she had stunned the players, it was followed by doubts. What was wrong with this beautiful girl?

"Amnesia." Han Xiao pointed at his head and thought of an explanation. "That's why I was worried about her running around, so I took her with me. She has no place to go anyway."

"Such a beautiful girl is actually sick in the head. What a pity …" Second Prince shook his head.

"What do you know? This is called taking advantage of the situation." Pork Bun gave Han Xiao a wretched look, as if to say, "Brother, I understand you." Maple Moon and Rainy Kim immediately glared at him.

Han Xiao rolled his eyes. A bunch of indecent people. Can't they have any pure thoughts in their heads?

Mad Blade looked left and right. He felt that Aroshia was too calm. She did not look like someone who had lost her memory at all. He was puzzled. "I feel that she is weird. Can she communicate?"

This reminded Han Xiao. Horlaide had said that Aroshia still remembered the language. He immediately put on a translator for her and asked, "Can you speak?"

Aroshia heard this and finally reacted. She opened her mouth and said, "Yes."

Her voice was like the sound of a clear spring. It was clear and ethereal, making everyone feel comfortable. It was as if a pair of soft hands were comforting their ears. This made the players who had heard enough of Pork Bun's hoarse voice very satisfied.

"You really don't remember anything?" Han Xiao was refreshed. It was good that she could communicate.

"Yes."

"Then are you willing to come with us temporarily?"

"Yes."

"Uh, then do you need anything?"

"Anything is fine."

"… You have lost your memory. Don't you want to find out your identity?"

"It's okay."

Hearing this answer, everyone gasped. It was as if they could see the brilliance of the Buddha's nature in the dark.

How can this amnesia patient be so calm? No, this is not just amnesia. You should take your medicine, beauty!

Han Xiao was completely out of ideas. He smiled helplessly. "Then that's it. My team members will take care of you. You …"

At this time, Aroshia suddenly walked toward Han Xiao, leaned close to his face, and sniffed like a puppy. She said, "I seem to have sensed a certain aura on your body somewhere …"

Han Xiao was stunned and felt surprised. He continued to ask, but Aroshia shook her head and said, "I don't remember. I just feel that it's familiar."

"Strange …"

He could only suppress his doubts and let everyone settle down. In any case, Aroshia did not eat, drink, or excrete. She was very easy to take care of. This was originally a characteristic of energy life forms. Aroshia was a normal life form. He did not know why, but the good thing was that he did not have to worry about her starving to death.

Han Xiao took the aircraft all the way to the office building and met Jenny in the office on the top floor.

Jenny had a serious expression and asked, "Can you confirm that they're Dark-star?"

Han Xiao nodded and explained what had happened in detail. He hid his personal information such as the interface and changed it to that he knew Ashes. In the end, he added, "Ashes is the next generation ace that Dark-star is cultivating. There must be a huge secret behind this operation. Although we're a neutral organization, and the conflict between Dark-star and Godora has nothing to do with us, they have to pay a corresponding price for daring to cause trouble on Floating Dragon Island."

Jenny nodded, pushed her glasses, and said with a frown, "Dark-star has always been peaceful with us. There must be a reason for this, but I'm not interested in understanding their intentions. I only want to find out who is responsible. Luckily, you recognized their background. Otherwise, Dark-star would have really escaped. When Her Excellency Ames returns, Dark-star will pay the price for this provocation."

Successfully causing trouble for Dark-star, Han Xiao nodded in his mind. To deal with a large organization, using someone else to do the dirty work was naturally the best way. Dark-star was very secretive and powerful. If he did not wait for the storyline to start, Han Xiao would not be able to do anything to them. However, Dark-star had personally given him an opportunity, so how could he not make use of it?

With Ames' personality and her recent bad mood, Dark-star could be said to have bumped into the muzzle of a gun. It was a pity that Ames was not on Floating Dragon Island at the moment. Otherwise, she would have directly killed Dark-star's future ace while he was still growing. That would have been a huge blow to Dark-star.

Floating Dragon would not reveal any information and let Dark-star think that they were safe. They would then deal with them when the time came. Because Han Xiao had joined Floating Dragon Island, he was able to borrow the power of one of the largest organizations in the Shattered Star Ring.

All along, Han Xiao had been using his advantage very well. At this moment, he finally flapped his wings in the galaxy. The complicated relationship between the various civilizations was hundreds of times more complicated than that of Blue Star. Even if he caused a small ripple, it could lead to a huge tsunami after being catalyzed by many parties.
